title: Construction of High-Level Bridge on Aurad–Sadashivgad SH-34 at Km 58.400 (Dadgi Village), Bhalki Taluka
location: Dadgi Village, Bhalki Taluka, Bidar District, Karnataka
description: Detailed Project Report for the construction of a 150 m long, 2-lane High-Level Bridge across the Dadgi River at Km 58.400 on SH-34 (Aurad–Sadashivgad Road), replacing the existing submersible bridge to provide safe, uninterrupted, all-weather connectivity, along with improvement of 0.730 km of approach roads. Vistaara Infra Consultants, Bengaluru, prepared the DPR, including surveys, investigations, hydrological and hydraulic studies, bridge design, drawings and cost estimates.
